action: No action needed; for awareness. UK organisations with breach-reporting duties may wish to confirm their process for reporting to the ICO is current.
exec: UK cyber incident reporting is at a record high while reported ransomware falls, pointing to other attack types driving breaches.
plain: The UK privacy regulator received a record 1,371 reports of cyber incidents between July and September 2026, though reports of ransomware keep falling.

key_findings: The ICO's data security incident trends page covers Q3 2026 and was last updated on 26 October 2026.
1,371 cyber incidents were reported to the ICO between July and September 2026, a record for any three-month period, per a news analysis of that data.
All data security incidents reached 4,604 in the same quarter, also a quarterly high, per the same analysis.
Ransomware reports fell from 1,253 in 2023 to 752 in 2024 and 620 in 2025, with 321 in the first nine months of 2026.
The ICO page presents its figures in an embedded dashboard that could not be read, so the numbers were not checked against it.
recommendations: The ICO page and the coverage read contain no guidance from the regulator.

summary: The Record's analysis of the ICO's published security incident data found 1,371 cyber incidents reported between July and September 2026, the most in any quarter, within a record 4,604 data security incidents overall. Ransomware reports keep falling: 1,253 in 2023, 752 in 2024, 620 in 2025 and 321 in the first nine months of 2026. The ICO dataset itself was not read.
title: Record 1,371 cyber incidents reported to UK's ICO in one quarter

validation.note: The ICO's data security incident trends page loaded: it covers Q3 2026 and was last updated on 26 October 2026, but the figures sit in an embedded dashboard that could not be read. The numbers therefore still rest on The Record's analysis.

review.note: Compared 1,371 cyber incidents Jul-Sep, 4,604 total, ransomware 1,253/752/620/321 against The Record (13 Nov); ICO dashboard unread, as the record says.
